title: That Old Black Magic: Flesh and Bone
start: Speak to Zommy 'Brains' Walker in the City of Um's bandstand.
prereq_quests: That Old Black Magic: My One and Only Lute

steps.t: Talk to Zommy 'Brains' Walker (red pin on map to the right) at the centre of the City of Um, behind Death, to accept the subquest.
Head north-east to talk to the Former Master Crafter (blue pin on map to the right). [Chat: 1 Ask about piano keys.]
Talk to him to give him 520 bone runes and 360 flesh runes. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 1 Yes.]
Take the white and black piano keys from the Former Master Crafter and return to Zommy.
Give Zommy the piano keys. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
